BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.dialogue.welcom: I wouldn't call it scavenging. I simply take the treasures others leave behind.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.dialogue.refres: Take a look at this new stock.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.dialogue.sell_m: You came prepared. I'll make it worth your while.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.dialogue.sold: Keeping goods in circulation benefits us both.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.dialogue.no_gol: You'll need a little more gold for that.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BUY_SE: Good morning, good afternoon, and good night.
You give me the Originium, and I give you the goods. Don't worry too much about the details.
We may be old friends, but business is business.
Why am I helping you? Think of it as an investment.
Buy short, sell long. Getting more with less. We dabble in the same business, you and I.
I'm not picking up the scraps. I'm just taking the treasure nobody else wanted.
You want to hear a story? Of course, my friend, but good tales don't come cheap.
We meet again, friend. What are you buying this time?
Long time no see, old friend. Good to know you're still alive and kicking.
My wares are not just for Terrans. I also sell to creatures that fly through the sky or roam the land.
What do you fancy? Gifts of nature, crafted goods, or the very concepts that first descended upon this land? I have them all.
You need manpower? I got you. No need to hesitate.
Found someone you like? Take them along. The price is perfectly reasonable.
This is way cheaper than looking everywhere for a Messenger.
You guys at Rhodes Island have all sorts of weirdos, huh...
I know, everyone has their own affairs to attend to.
You need help, but that help's not going to be free.
Mind if I have a look-see at Rhodes Island's aircraft? No? Too bad.
Fangs and claws are just as useful here. You have a good eye.
There is a limit to being choosy. These are the best helpers you can hire.
Meeting a person in the Blackflow Wildwoods is not necessarily a good thing, is it?
A companion on the road, whether they can talk or not, beats listening to the hounds howl.
Don't worry. Spending money can make the world turn 'round.
Don't be too high-maintenance, picking up all these scraps was very hard work.
A fully armed society must surely be a civilized society.
What's this thing good for? Why, buy it and find out!
Everything untouched by the Blackflow is right here. No need to hesitate.
Your chance of finding a poisonous mushroom in the Wildwoods is one hundred percent. Here, it is zero.
I once bought a whole crate of Honey Biscuits, but this Perro girl made off with the lot of them.
Most customers in the Blackflow Wildwoods are decisive and say little—if the sounds they make can be called language.
Be more accepting of nature’s gifts. Whatever the Wildwoods offer, take it.
Do you need a set of instructions? I mean—never mind.
Swimming in the Blackflow is hardly a good idea, friend. Though you may not have much of a choice.
Be prepared for anything. Better safe than sorry, friend.
This little thing is equal parts worthless and terrifying...
What's this thing for? Good question, I don't know either.
Honestly, valuing these things is not my specialty. Trading them, however, still is.
These things are not easy to take out of the Blackflow Wildwoods. In here, though, you cannot do without them, can you?
I can tell your parts box needs this. That is precisely why I am here.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BANK_E: Check out this new toy. The Prospective Investment System. Use your extra riches to pave the way for the future.
Always think long-term. With enough wealth, life's possibilities are endless. That's a good thing, my friend.
Terrans are not the only ones who hoard things. Have you seen the acorns in a fangsquirrel’s burrow?
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BANK_I: You're an optimistic one. Try your hand at investing in the future, and you won't regret it, friend.
Don't let the spending get to you. You'll get it back in the future when you need it.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BANK_F: There's a withdrawal limit, but I'm willing to free up some space to bring you more practical goods. Thanks for always being so understanding, my friend.
Oh, looks like there's a little problem with our investment return system...
Looks like our investment system's got a few bugs... Maybe come back next time?
Looks like our investment system's running into trouble again. Mr. D's equipment's not as stable as he says, eh?
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BANK_W: Now's the time to thank your past self for your foresight. Am I right, friend?
There's always a return on investment. Well, not really, but everyone likes to think so.
A little investment here and there'll eventually help you overcome anything. Can't hurt, anyway.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BANK_R: Your investment reserves have gone up, friend. It's a good thing.
With your investment reserves, you can set out on your adventures with confidence.
Wonderful! Your next adventure will go much more smoothly. Probably.
Ah, I can see right away you're a cautious one. Maybe a little too cautious.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.OUTER_: I only take a small commission for your investments in future adventures. It's a fair deal.
There is an old Bolivarian saying: better to take precautions than regret it later. Very sensible, if you ask me.
I got myself some new trinkets. You'll love them.
You should invest in your upcoming adventures!
I do thank you for your support, friend. Let's keep working together.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.FIGHT_: The value of my wares will go down if you leave too many fingerprints on them, my friend.
Hand me the Ingots first, and you can touch that all you like.
Don't like my wares? Prices giving you second thoughts?
Oh, do be careful. You break it, you buy it.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.BUY_CO: Thank you for your patronage. Do have a look at the rest too.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SHOP.DIALOGUE.RECYCL: Something good for me? With our roles reversed, I will naturally offer a fair price.
You came prepared. I will make it worth your while.
The products of the Blackflow Wildwoods have their own system of appraisal. Trust me, friend, I know it well.
A little wear will not affect the appraisal. Of course I mean it.
I have seen this before. Not easy to find, was it? You deserve something for your trouble.
These things are scarcely older than infants. How nostalgic.
Saying goodbye to parts? Never heard of it. Is it not better to be reunited with your ingots?
Out with the old, in with the new. I will bring better goods next time. I hope you have enough ingots then.
Put everything to use. What you no longer need is useful to me. We both win.
